unknownFieldPolicy: ParseMockWorkersConfig uses json.Decoder.DisallowUnknownFields and rejects unknown top-level keys, unknown nested keys, and trailing JSON values
entrySelectionPolicy: first matching mockWorkers[] entry wins; there is no response-sequence or multi-hit authoring surface beyond that first-match selection

runTypeUnion.summary: runType is required on every mockWorkers[] entry and selects which nested config shape Validate enforces

values.nestedConfigPolicy: no nested config required; scriptConfig and rejectConfig are ignored when present
scriptConfig is required; scriptConfig.command is required non-empty
rejectConfig is optional; rejectConfig.exitCode when set must be between 1 and 255

unmatchedDispatchPolicies.summary: default when unmatchedDispatchPolicy is omitted; unmatched dispatches return the synthetic accepted mock result
explicit accept policy; same default-accept behavior as omission
unmatched dispatches execute through the normal worker runner/provider path

validationBoundaries.condition: unknown top-level or nested JSON field
trailing JSON after the root object

validationBoundaries.errorPattern: unmatchedDispatchPolicy must be one of "accept" or "passthrough"
runType must be one of "accept", "script", or "reject"
scriptConfig is required when runType is "script"

validationBoundaries.condition: runType script with scriptConfig missing command
validationBoundaries.errorPattern: scriptConfig.command is required when runType is "script"

notAcceptedCapabilities.reason: no media payload or media-response authoring fields are accepted by ParseMockWorkersConfig
no per-entry delay, sleep, or dispatch-timing fields are accepted; scriptConfig.timeout only bounds local script execution
no artifact upload/download or artifact payload fields are accepted on mockWorkers entries
no multi-step response sequence authoring exists beyond first-match mockWorkers[] entry selection

fields.defaultEmptyBehavior: missing mockWorkers decodes as an empty slice; nil after decode is normalized to []
fields.notes: LoadMockWorkersConfig with an empty path returns NewEmptyMockWorkersConfig without reading a file

omitted workInputs does not constrain consumed work-input selectors
